competitions.result: Semi-final — lost 1–0 to Arsenal in the third replay.
Semi-final — lost 2–1 on aggregate to Nottingham Forest.
First round — lost 4–2 on aggregate to Dinamo Tbilisi.

overview: Liverpool retained the First Division title under Bob Paisley, finishing on 60 points, two ahead of Manchester United. They were unbeaten at Anfield in the league and scored 81 league goals. The season also brought the Charity Shield, with Arsenal beaten 3–1 at Wembley.

David Johnson led the scoring with 27 goals in all competitions. Terry McDermott became the first player to win the football writers’ and PFA player awards in the same season. Emlyn Hughes left for Wolves, while Ronnie Whelan and Ian Rush joined from Home Farm and Chester City respectively.

Liverpool reached both domestic cup semi-finals but went no further: Nottingham Forest won their League Cup tie, while Arsenal needed three FA Cup replays before winning 1–0. Dinamo Tbilisi ended Liverpool’s European Cup campaign in the first round, overturning a 2–1 Anfield defeat with a 3–0 home win.

events.detail: Liverpool beat Aston Villa 4–1 at Anfield.
